actor: High-bandwidth-memory manufacturer's fab production and yield-engineering operation
job: Running HBM3E/HBM4 and DRAM fabs at full utilization and lifting yields to ship every available die into the AI-memory shortage.
outcome: Two consecutive quarters of shipped HBM/DRAM volume that, at scarcity pricing, keep reported YoY revenue growth at or above 100%.
motivation: Sold-out capacity means every incremental die converts directly to high-margin revenue before new fabs erode scarcity in about two years.

task.what: Ramp HBM/DRAM wafer output and yields
task.where: Existing HBM and DRAM fabrication lines
task.why: Convert scarce capacity into shippable revenue
task.how: HBM3E/HBM4 process nodes, TSV stacking, yield optimization

actor: High-bandwidth-memory manufacturer's DRAM/HBM pricing and sales-contract function
job: Negotiating and holding premium contract prices (ASPs) with memory buyers across the Q2 and Q3 supply-constrained quarters.
outcome: Blended selling prices high enough that revenue clears the triple-digit YoY bar even as the 2025 comparison base rises.
motivation: The supply crunch hands the seller pricing power; locking premium ASPs now maximizes revenue before capacity additions soften prices.

task.who: DRAM/HBM pricing, sales, and account teams
task.what: Set and lock premium HBM/DRAM contract prices
task.where: Quarterly supply-agreement and price negotiations with buyers
task.why: Turn scarcity into premium average selling prices

job: Pre-booking and locking HBM/DRAM allocations to feed AI-accelerator production ramps whose memory need outruns available fab capacity.
outcome: Sustained sold-out order books at the memory maker, keeping both volume and price high enough for triple-digit growth.
motivation: Memory is the binding bottleneck for AI-accelerator shipments; securing allocation early protects buildout timelines against the shortage.

task.who: Accelerator vendors' and hyperscalers' component-procurement teams
task.what: Pre-book and lock HBM/DRAM supply allocations
task.where: Supply contracts and allocation deals with memory makers
task.why: Memory bottlenecks accelerator shipments; lock supply early
task.how: Long-term purchase agreements, advance payments, allocation deals
